scope: Original frozen 30-input FP64 0/1/3% study retained in qubo; separate best-observed strict envelope and complete 13-input FP32 follow-up are explicit. No quantum advantage or universal improvement claimed.
solver: Research FEM, not the public CPU reference or educational Adam solver.
timing: FEM on A100-PCIE-40GB; KaHyPar one i7-12700 CPU thread, differing soft budgets. FEM component sums include certified modes, setup, search and all-replica descent.

strict_followup.selection_scope: Lowest verified strict cut from the original policy and all four follow-up runs where performed; all 1%/3% results unchanged. This envelope is not a single-policy or equal-budget benchmark.
strict_followup.timing_scope: Search loops include checkpoints; cached-mode construction, state archival and independent audits excluded. Follow-up timing cannot replace historical charged pipeline costs.

protocol.selection: minimum native cut among capacity-feasible checkpoints, both block labels accepted in both arms
protocol.endpoint: unmodified vertex bits; exact conditional binary auxiliaries; no vertex descent
